nav.label: Primary
rail.title: Chat
chat.empty-subtitle: I can search your meetings, summarize decisions, and find action items.
onboarding.name-hint: So when someone in a meeting says “Mike will send the doc” and that's you, Mnemos can attribute the action item to you — not just log it as text.
onboarding.name-required: Enter your first name to continue.
onboarding.runner-body: Mnemos runs extraction, memory, and chat through the coding assistant already installed on your machine — no separate API key.
onboarding.install-step-1: 1. Follow the install steps in the docs
onboarding.runner-caption: You need at least one working AI assistant to use Mnemos. More runners (Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Ollama) are coming in a future release — you'll pick one, not several.
onboarding.permissions-body: Mnemos needs to hear you and your call — both stay on this device and are never uploaded.
onboarding.perm-screen-rationale: To capture the other side of your calls — Zoom, Meet, Teams, browser audio. macOS requires this permission for system-audio capture too; Mnemos never records your screen or takes screenshots, only audio.
onboarding.perm-denied-hint: Off in System Settings. Open it, enable Mnemos, then come back here — it rechecks automatically.
onboarding.perm-screen-restart-prompt: Already turned it on in System Settings? macOS only applies Screen Recording after a restart. Relaunching starts setup over — it's quick.
onboarding.perm-relaunch-hint: Screen Recording may need Mnemos to be quit and reopened before it actually takes effect — a macOS quirk, not a bug. Do that before your first recording if capture doesn't pick up the other side of your call.
onboarding.perm-not-applicable: Windows doesn't require an explicit permission grant for microphone or system-audio access — nothing to do here, you're all set.
onboarding.models-body: One time only. After this, Mnemos transcribes fully offline.
onboarding.models-note-progress: This keeps going in the background even if you switch away — continue once it finishes.
onboarding.models-note-done: Ready. Mnemos can transcribe fully offline from here.
